DATE: Union endorsements landed w/c 13 July 2026, ahead of nominations closing.
NOT a Saturday 18 July development.

REPORTED CONTENT:
- All 11 of Labour's affiliated trade unions backed Andy Burnham for leader as nominations
  closed: ASLEF, Community, CWU, FBU, GMB, MU, NUM, TSSA, Unison, Unite and Usdaw.
- All 12 socialist societies that nominate for leader also backed him.
  (Both figures attributed to Pippa Crerar on X — UNCONFIRMED against approved sources.)
- UNISON's endorsement was taken by the union's Labour Link committee.

QUOTE (snippet-sourced, UNCONFIRMED against approved sources):
Linda Hobson, chair of UNISON's Labour Link committee — described Burnham as
"a strong, powerful voice who commands respect" with "a good relationship with unions".

NO trade union, CBI or business-group reaction specifically DATED Saturday 18 July 2026 was
found in any approved source.
